videos.description: A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: Lisa and Lewis tackle a troublesome lad with a potty mouth, followed by a trip to the canal, where a member of the public has heard gunshots. Phil Broughton is hot on the heels of a fail-to-stop Ford pushing speeds of over a ton.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: A van driver blocks himself into a dead end and repeatedly rams the interceptors' car, a self-confident drink driver gets argumentative, and reports arrive of a wanted vehicle travelling towards the Nottinghamshire border.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: After speeding at over 100mph and driving on the wrong side of the road, the driver of a two-tonne pickup rams an interceptor's car before the rest of the team pitch in to help out.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: The interceptors are on a mission to lock up a man wanted on suspicion of making threats to kill, who could have a knife. Rob and Dan stakeout the suspect's car, but they're so super stealthy that a driver reverses into them, blowing their cover.

videos.title: Traffic Cops
videos.description: Even though it's only just after 10am, a woman is suspected of drink-driving and traffic cop Matt Copestake is called to investigate. Traffic cop Andy Swift is on the trail of a driver who has allegedly failed to stop after a collision.

videos.title: Traffic Cops
videos.description: Cops are on the hunt for stolen cars, and a traffic cop ends up on a 100-mile chase down the M1. Officers pursue a stolen car being driven by a wanted prolific criminal, police in Yorkshire spot a stolen van.

videos.title: Traffic Cops
videos.description: During a busy Spring Bank Holiday, the traffic cops deal with the effects of drink and drugs. A dangerous drunk driver leads traffic cops on a 20-minute chase through busy areas; a drunk driver dangerously weaves down a busy dual carriageway.

videos.title: Traffic Cops
videos.description: In central Derbyshire, the Traffic Cops are on the hunt for a car linked to the theft of two motorbikes. After a 10-minute search, officers spot the car. Near the M1 motorway, a gang of suspected truck thieves risk it all to escape the cops.

videos.title: Four Guns to the Border
videos.description: A group of outlaws plan and execute a robbery in a small town. However, things go awry as the team attempt a getaway, when a couple of the locals attempting to follow them, are ambushed by marauding natives.

videos.title: Ride Beyond Vengeance
videos.description: Mistaken for a rustler, a buffalo hunter is robbed and branded by a banker and his henchmen when he is on the way home to his wife with the money he has saved up.

videos.title: Big Jake
videos.description: The avenging head of the McCandle clan returns to his estranged family and leads the search for his kidnapped grandson. Big Jake sets off, his sons in tow, to deliver the ransom to the kidnappers, but has little intention of handing it over without a fight.

videos.description: As Doggett continues his investigation of Deputy Director Kersh, he attempts to uncover the truth about a woman with superhuman abilities who may or may not be aiding his cause, and is somehow connected to scientific experiments being conducted on a World War II-era marine vessel.
